summary: A horizontally scrolling desktop page (one long row of 900px-tall colour panels; a plain vertical stack on mobile) for a free chromatic signage family. Fitting the subject, chapter headings run vertically in Rotated Shade, and the site's centrepiece is a layer-by-layer colour and sign builder that exports SVG, PNG and PDF.

Fieldset.expander collapses and expands
reconstruction.content: Default text 'Tester'; themes such as red-on-white, red-on-dark, blue-on-dark, teal, cool-blues, peach-orange-purple, sherman; alternates: Alternate A M N W X Y, Round E, Simplified I, Simplified L, Alternate ampersand, Small apostrophe
reconstruction.assets: Colour-layer font files and banner-shape glyphs; a server endpoint for SVG, PNG and PDF export
reconstruction.html: section#tester > figure#preview.bungee[data-max-font-size=30vh] > div > .layer.background + .layer.text.regular|inline|shade; form#controls > #text-control, #orientation-controls, fieldset.expander#preset-controls (#palettes), #layer-controls (.swatch[data-layer] + input.layercolors), #banner-controls (radios begin-*, end-*, block-*), #stylistic-sets (checkbox name=alt), #save-share (#permalink, #download-svg/png/pdf, #view-code)
